system: List every identifying detail in the text (names, places, organisations, dates, numbers, contacts) with a close, plausible substitute of the same kind, exactly as each appears in the text. One entry per distinct detail; related forms (a first name used alone, a name inside an email) get matching substitutes. Reply with JSON only: {"replacements": [{"original": "...", "replacement": "..."}]}. No details: {"replacements": []}.
